presentation_type.definition: How the patient presented: abdominal swelling or suspicious mass, or a renal tumor found on imaging.

tumor_laterality.definition: Whether renal tumor(s) are on one kidney or both kidneys, as stated by imaging or pathology.

multifocal_wt.definition: Wilms tumor with more than one focus, as stated by imaging or pathology.

predisposing_condition.definition: Patient has a known cancer predisposition syndrome or genetic condition associated with Wilms tumor.

initial_workup_assessment.definition: Clinician's overall assessment after initial history, laboratory tests and imaging. Judgement; no case text states it directly.

wt_diagnosis_status.definition: Whether Wilms tumor is only suspected clinically or has been confirmed by pathology.

anaplasia_type.definition: Anaplasia on pathology: none, focal, or diffuse.

stage.definition: Tumor stage as stated in the case description.

complete_necrosis.definition: Pathology reports complete necrosis of the tumor.

combined_loh_1p_16q.definition: Combined loss of heterozygosity at 1p and 16q on tumor molecular testing.

loh_or_loi_11p15.definition: Loss of heterozygosity or loss of imprinting at 11p15 on tumor molecular testing.

gain_1q_positive.definition: 1q gain is present on tumor molecular testing.

metastasis_pattern.definition: Sites of distant metastasis at diagnosis or at re-staging.

renal_tumor_response.definition: Response of the renal tumor(s) at the most recent re-imaging stated in the case (week 6 or week 12).

lung_metastases_response_week6.definition: Response of lung metastases at the week 6 re-imaging.

tumor_resectable.definition: Surgeon's judgement that the renal tumor(s) can be completely removed by surgery at the time point named in the box. Judgement; no case text states it directly.

resectable_by_partial_nephrectomy.definition: Surgeon's judgement that partial nephrectomy (one or both sides for bilateral tumors) is feasible at the time point named in the box. Judgement; no case text states it directly.

resectable_by_bilateral_partial_nephrect.definition: Surgeon's judgement that partial nephrectomy on both kidneys is feasible at the time point named in the box. Judgement; no case text states it directly.

definitive_treatment_received.definition: Nephrectomy already performed on the renal tumor: primary nephrectomy at diagnosis, or a later partial or total nephrectomy. 'none' if no nephrectomy has been done.

whole_abdominal_irradiation_planned.definition: Whole abdominal irradiation is given or planned.

complex_surgery_planned.definition: Clinician judgement that the planned surgery is complex. Judgement; no case text states it directly.

disease_extent.definition: Localized (no distant metastasis) or metastatic, computed from metastasis_pattern.

pathology_subtype.definition: Favorable histology (no anaplasia) split by blastemal predominance, or focal or diffuse anaplasia.

unfavorable_biomarkers.definition: Any unfavorable biomarker: combined LOH at 1p and 16q, or LOH/LOI at 11p15.

lung_biomarker_response_group.definition: Combined result of 1p/16q combined LOH, 1q gain, and week 6 lung metastasis response.

risk_group_fhwt.definition: Risk group for favorable-histology Wilms tumor after primary nephrectomy. The classification criteria are not printed in schema_input.txt, so no rules are encoded. Add the printed criteria as rules before use.
risk_group_fhwt.criteria_source: none: criteria not printed in boxes or footnotes

notes.predicates: Conditions were drafted and reviewed by a language model (model_reviewed), not by clinicians. 'rejected' means the review rejected the draft; the box then needs clinician judgement. 'section_only' means the box only requires the patient to be in the page's guideline section.
notes.coordinates: bbox and line_bboxes are PDF points with the origin at the page's top left; pages[].size gives the page size.
notes.links: page links name a page id from pages[]; a multi-page code such as PROS-F has ids 'PROS-F 1 of 5' ... ; external_guideline links name another guideline's slug.
notes.reextracted_pages: Pages listed in quality.reextracted_pages were typed as footnote pages (or had no boxes) although they hold flowcharts. Their boxes, arrows and conditions were written from the PDF page by a language-model reviewer (data/<slug>/page_specs/<page>.json, nccn_nav.page_spec) and are not clinician-validated; arrows are image_checked, conditions model_reviewed or none. pages[].kind_before keeps the earlier kind.
